tex_content.html:
Proposition
[$\Gamma ^k_{ij}$ in terms of the metric]

Source: petersen:page-0084, petersen:page-0085 ↗ def:pet-ch2-christoffel-symbols-second-kind ↗ rem:pet-ch2-koszul-formula

$\displaystyle \Gamma ^k_{ij}=\tfrac 12g^{k\ell }\big(\partial _ig_{\ell j}+\partial _jg_{\ell i}-\partial _\ell g_{ij}\big)$.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch2-christoffel-formula

\sketch Apply Koszul’s formula to the commuting coordinate fields $\partial _i,\partial _j,\partial _\ell $:

\[ 2\Gamma ^k_{ij}g_{k\ell } =\partial _i g_{j\ell }+\partial _j g_{i\ell } -\partial _\ell g_{ij}. \]

Contracting with $g^{\ell m}$ gives the asserted formula.

□
